name: Khan Shaka

narrative.details: You help the Magram, and I like you.  Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis!  He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head!  I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText: Khan Shaka is dead!  I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do tasks for the Magram, and I will help you.
